results.name: Wildfires in Montenegro
results.reason: From 10 August, wildfires have affected various parts of Montenegro. The event affected mostly around Podgorica, the capital. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide initial rough estimation, wildfire extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.
